_meta.purpose: Labeled benchmark of PUBLISHED stem-loop RT-qPCR assays with MEASURED performance, used to calibrate SCORING_WEIGHTS via constrained regression (SPEC_phase5 PART B).
honesty_rules: Only entries with verified==true enter the regression fit.
Do NOT invent efficiency numbers. Per-assay values must be transcribed from the paper's tables/supplements and cited with source_doi + source_pmid.
Where a paper reports only a RANGE (not per-assay values), leave verified=false and record the range in notes until an individual value is confirmed.
target for regression = 100 - |efficiency_pct - 100|  (100 = ideal amplification efficiency, MIQE09).
sources: [Wang17] Mol Med Rep 2017;17(3):3690-3696 DOI 10.3892/mmr.2017.8297 (PMID 29257343): let-7 panel amplification efficiencies 0.9288-1.1403 (range reported).
[Kunwar23] Diagnostics 2023;13(13):2170 DOI 10.3390/diagnostics13132170 (PMID 37443567): 24-miRNA CogniMIR panel, R^2 0.94-0.99, detectable to ~20 copies; stem-loop TaqMan vs LNA.
[Chen05] Nucleic Acids Res 2005;33(20):e179: original stem-loop TaqMan miRNA assays.

[Busk14] BMC Bioinformatics 2014;15:29 DOI 10.1186/1471-2105-15-29 (PMID 24472427): miRprimer; 164 validated primers, 93+-5% worked first try; efficiencies close to 100%; discriminates 1-nt siblings (let-7a/f, miR-200b/c, miR-23a/b) at 0.1-1% off-target.

[Kang17] RNA 2017;24(3):304-312 DOI 10.1261/rna.061150.117 (PMID 29208706): miPrimer; 120 primer pairs, 95.6%/93.3% success (non-family/family), efficiency 90-110%; dimer dG cutoff -9.0+-1 kcal/mol; Tm 59-60C.
_meta.note_on_method: Busk14/Kang17 use non-Chen universal systems, so their PRIMER SEQUENCES are not directly comparable to this tool (Chen stem-loop). But the miRNA TARGETS below were experimentally confirmed as qPCR-friendly and are valid real-world targets for cross-validation of THIS tool's designs (deterministic + plausibility + family discrimination).

assays.notes: let-7 panel efficiency reported as RANGE 0.9288-1.1403; transcribe per-member value from the paper before setting verified=true. Primer sequences are in the paper's primer table (not machine-extractable here).
See wang17_let7a_5p. Fill per-member efficiency from paper.
24-miRNA panel; R^2 range 0.94-0.99 reported. Extract individual miRNA ids + efficiency/R^2 from the article/supplement, then split into one entry per miRNA with verified=true.

functional_targets._doc: Real miRNA targets experimentally confirmed as functional qPCR assays in the cited papers. outcome_functional=true is a published fact (assay worked). efficiency_pct is null where the paper reports only an aggregate range (do not fabricate per-assay values). Use these for: (1) deterministic + plausibility cross-validation of THIS tool's designs (copy into validation/reference_mirnas.json), and (2) family-discrimination checks. Promote to the 'assays' fit set only after a per-assay efficiency is transcribed and verified=true.

targets.note: miPrimer example; forward dimer dG -10.44 kcal/mol flagged
